transform: Same source crop, PIL bilinear to 64x64 RGB uint8, then horizontal reflection. One additional inference only for already-selected accepted blue detections.
rule: Keep blue detection only if mirrored crop also predicts accepted blue at the unchanged 0.8 threshold. Original scores and boxes unchanged; no suppressed detection resurrection, no reselection. Red decisions unchanged.
motivation: TRAIN spatial probe preserved all 29 blue crops under mirroring and reduced accepted clutter. Transformed views are not new labeled training data.
design: Freeze before scene evaluation. Screen64 complete TRAIN scenes, then all three related repeated development panels regardless of outcome. Report identity-level target losses and added calls. No threshold sweep or development fitting. No Pi performance claims without direct timing.
